traits.name: Arcane Insights
traits.text:
The windwalker has advantage on
saving throws against spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Natural Recovery (2/Day)
traits.text:
When the windwalker
finishes a short rest, it can regain up to 4 total
expended spell slots.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.text: The windwalker is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is wisdom (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). The windwalker has the following druid spells prepared: * Cantrips (at will): druidcraft, gust, thunderclap * 1st level (4 slots): entangle, faerie fire, fog cloud * 2nd level (3 slots): barkskin, gust of wind, levitate, misty step * 3rd level (3 slots): call lightning, fly, sleet storm, wind wall * 4th level (3 slots): no spells learned for this level * 5th level (1 slot): no spells learned for this level

traits.name: Wild Shape Giant Eagle (2/Day)
traits.text:
As a bonus action,
the windwalker transforms into a giant eagle for up
to four hours. When the eagle is reduced to 0 hit
points, the windwalker reverts to its normal form,
with any excess damage carrying over to the
windwalker's hit points.

traits.name: Wind Shield
traits.text:
The area around the windwalker is
enveloped in chaotic winds. The area within 15 feet
of the windwalker is considered difficult terrain for
enemy creatures. Additionally, ranged attacks
against the windwalker are made with disadvantage.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach
5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d8 - 1) bludgeoning
damage, or 4 (1d10 - 1) bludgeoning damage if
used with two hands.
